enrichment.description: Venue Apartments is an established residential apartment building located in San Francisco's Mission Bay neighborhood offering studio, one-, and two-bedroom floor plans.

enrichment.hook: Upscale apartment living located near Oracle Park and the Chase Center in Mission Bay.
enrichment.description: An established residential apartment community offering units and amenities in San Francisco's waterfront Mission Bay district.

enrichment.hook: The San Francisco Bay Ferry's high-speed passenger ferry vessel.
enrichment.description: MV Zalophus is a high-speed passenger ferry operating as part of the San Francisco Bay Ferry fleet, which is managed from the Ferry Building terminal area.

enrichment.hook: A 400-passenger high-speed catamaran operating as part of the San Francisco Bay Ferry fleet out of the Ferry Building.
enrichment.description: The M/V Hydrus is a public transit passenger vessel operated by the Water Emergency Transportation Authority (WETA) providing regular commuter service from the San Francisco Ferry Building.

enrichment.hook: Sustainable home textile brand corporate office and registration address.
enrichment.description: Coyuchi, Inc. is an established sustainable home textile and organic bedding company utilizing this location for corporate or administrative operations rather than a newly opened public retail storefront.

enrichment.hook: A Mexican eatery located on Marin Street offering street tacos and traditional favorites.
enrichment.description: Bonita Chilanga Taqueria is an active food business operating at 2560 Marin Street in San Francisco, offering delivery and pickup options.

enrichment.hook: An arch-filled California restaurant in the Ferry Building from the team behind Michelin-starred Sorrel.
enrichment.description: Located in Shop #5 of the historic Ferry Building, Arquet is an ingredient-driven restaurant helmed by chef Alex Hong and operations director Joel Wilkerson, featuring wood-fired cooking and local produce.

enrichment.hook: Popular Bay Area Filipino-Mexican fusion brand known for its signature sisig burritos, tacos, and street food.
enrichment.description: A new food truck permit registration for the established Bay Area fusion concept Señor Sisig at Shafter Avenue.

enrichment.hook: A popular Bay Area Filipino-Mexican fusion food truck and restaurant brand operating since 2010.
enrichment.description: Señor Sisig is an established Bay Area staple known for serving modern Filipino street food fusion, featuring signature items like sisig tacos and burritos.

enrichment.hook: A collaborative neighborhood wine bar and Vietnamese pop-up operating inside the former Outer Orbit space in La Lengua.
enrichment.description: Founded by Jessica Bell of Fat Cat Wine Club alongside chef Kevin Tang of Claws of Mantis, this vibrant spot serves natural wines, beers, and creative Vietnamese-inspired dishes.

enrichment.hook: Set to be the first-ever café space in San Francisco's Sunnydale neighborhood.
enrichment.description: Bold City Coffee Co. is an upcoming community-focused café located in the Nia Building at 1537 Sunnydale Avenue, operated as a mission-driven enterprise by the Greater Life Church to provide local jobs and youth scholarships.

enrichment.hook: A workplace hospitality cafe concept by Porter operating in the lobby of 560 Mission Street.
enrichment.description: Presse is an all-day cafe located at 560 Mission Street, serving coffee, specialty drinks, pastries, and quick bites.

enrichment.hook: A family-owned Filipino food concept operating out of Chug Pub in the Sunset district.
enrichment.description: Pinoy's Place by Kusina serves traditional Filipino home-style dishes and silog meals, operating out of the Chug Pub space on Lincoln Way.

enrichment.hook: Thai eatery offering delivery, takeout, and catering options at 1200 Market Street.
enrichment.description: Krua Thai serves a menu of classic Thai dishes, noodles, and curries with active delivery and pickup listings online.

enrichment.display_name: San Francisco Optics by Alexander Daas
enrichment.hook: A long-standing Marina District eyewear boutique featuring luxury frames and independent designer collections.
enrichment.description: Located on Chestnut Street, San Francisco Optics by Alexander Daas offers custom eyewear styling and designer frames in the Marina District.

enrichment.hook: An online-based business offering contemporary Cambodian-inspired clothing, art prints, and accessories.
enrichment.description: Mealea Collection is a small business specializing in modern Khmer fashion, apparel like krama textiles, art prints, and handmade accessories. While registered with a San Francisco mailing/permit address, it operates primarily as an e-commerce brand and vendor at local pop-ups and night markets rather than a traditional physical storefront.

enrichment.hook: San Francisco's first café dedicated to specialty coffee from India, sourced directly from the owners' family farm.
enrichment.description: Founded by Milana Ram and Himanshu Bhaisare, Le Mil's Coffee brings single-origin beans and South Indian filter coffee from Chikmagalur to a permanent brick-and-mortar space on Polk Street.

enrichment.hook: An independent platform providing AI agent management, monitoring, and supervision for enterprise users.
enrichment.description: Wayfound provides an agentic-native platform focused on tracking performance, ensuring compliance, and optimizing workflows for AI agents.

enrichment.hook: Popular Texas-style barbecue pop-up expanding to a second brick-and-mortar location in the Richmond District.
enrichment.description: Known for blending Texas-style smoked meats with Asian and Mexican roots (such as their signature brisket bao), Smokin D's BBQ is currently building out its new Richmond District location on Clement Street.

enrichment.hook: The RealReal returns to Union Square with its newly renovated, two-story flagship store.
enrichment.description: The RealReal has reopened its 8,100-square-foot Union Square flagship at 253 Post Street after a three-year closure. The two-story space offers authenticated designer resale, fine jewelry, watches, and dedicated areas for one-on-one consignor appointments.

enrichment.hook: A newly-registered business entity offering private catering services.
enrichment.description: Moni's Kitchen SF is a newly registered business entity located at 103 Horne Ave, operating primarily around private catering inquiries.

enrichment.hook: A fast-casual kitchen inside The Market at 1355 Market St centering on fresh, handmade gnocchi and small-batch sauces.
enrichment.description: Founded by Josh Berkowitz, Gno and Co. serves handmade gnocchi with rotating seasonal and vegan or gluten-free sauce options. It operates as part of the culinary collective at 1355 Market Street.

enrichment.hook: A thoughtfully curated Hayes Valley shop for home goods, independent design objects, and apparel.
enrichment.description: Founded by interior stylist Madeleine Shields, Sommer offers a considered collection of contemporary artisan wares, clothing, and lifestyle items housed in a renovated industrial space on Linden Street.

enrichment.hook: A Korean-inspired cafe and dessert spot in Hayes Valley offering salt bread sandos and specialty drinks.
enrichment.description: Located at 22 Franklin Street, The Buoy serves modern Korean-influenced cafe fare, pastries, and drinks such as black sesame lattes and salt bread sandos.

enrichment.hook: An expansion of the longtime Pier 39 cutlery shop, offering blades and professional edge-sharpening services in North Beach.
enrichment.description: We Be Knives on Powell is an active storefront location operating a few blocks away from Pier 39. The shop provides specialty cutlery, pocket knives, and walk-in knife sharpening services.

enrichment.hook: A warm, modern Mexican cantina in the Marina taking over the former Tipsy Pig space.
enrichment.description: Located at 2231 Chestnut Street, Lobalita is a modern Mexican cantina offering shared plates, intuitive cocktails, and a cozy atmosphere from local hospitality veterans.

enrichment.hook: A newly-permitted entity associated with the notable contemporary art gallery founded by Claudia Altman-Siegel.
enrichment.description: A business permit was filed for Altman Siegel LLC at 2116 Sutter St in San Francisco, though the well-known contemporary art gallery previously announced the closure of its Dogpatch location.

enrichment.hook: A private digital floral studio and delivery service specializing in Dutch Master-style arrangements and preserved rose boxes.
enrichment.description: Fleur Luxe Social Club operates as a private digital floral studio based out of the Mission Bay/Dogpatch area rather than a traditional walk-in storefront, offering delivery and local drop-off options.

enrichment.display_name: Project Open Hand (Ruth Brinker Meal Site)
enrichment.hook: A long-standing San Francisco nonprofit serving nutritious, medically tailored meals and groceries to the vulnerable and elderly.
enrichment.description: Located at 771 Ellis Street, this site serves as one of Project Open Hand's active Community Nutrition Program meal sites providing weekday lunches to seniors and adults with disabilities.

enrichment.hook: A massive new nightclub and restaurant concept in the Mission from the team behind Bar Part Time.
enrichment.description: Taking over the former Bissap Baobab space at 2243 Mission Street, Downtime is a forthcoming 6,000-square-foot venue featuring a dance floor, natural wine, cocktails by Eric Ochoa, and food from Berkeley's Rose Pizzeria.

enrichment.hook: San Francisco's first 100% gluten-free Italian trattoria from the team behind Montesacro.
enrichment.description: Created by Viviana Devoto and Gianluca Legrottaglie in the former Bettola space, Clementina offers a completely gluten-free menu of regional Italian dishes, pastas, and pizzas designed for both celiac diners and the broader community.

enrichment.hook: A longtime neighborhood coffee staple that relocated to 419 Castro Street.
enrichment.description: Castro Coffee Company is a long-standing independent coffee shop that moved its operations to 419 Castro Street adjacent to its previous location.

enrichment.hook: A residential apartment community located in the Mission Bay neighborhood of San Francisco.
enrichment.description: Edgewater is an established multi-family residential rental building located at 355 Berry Street offering studio to two-bedroom floor plans.

enrichment.hook: A tiny, vinyl-only Japanese jazz kissa and artisanal sake bar in Nob Hill.
enrichment.description: Located in a 400-square-foot storefront on Mason Street, Kissakeko is an intimate listening room featuring a curated vinyl collection paired with high-end sake.

enrichment.hook: An intentional, multi-course coffee tasting experience created in collaboration with Chef Seth Stowaway.
enrichment.description: Komakase offers a curated, omakase-inspired coffee tasting experience at 243 Front Street in collaboration with Chef Seth Stowaway at the Lore.

enrichment.hook: An established boutique specializing in independent, natural skincare and holistic beauty guidance.
enrichment.description: Ayla Beauty is a curated natural skincare and wellness shop offering hard-to-find botanical brands and personalized beauty consultations.

enrichment.hook: A vibrant Thai breakfast and brunch spot in West Portal from the team behind Khao Tiew.
enrichment.description: Located in the former Squat & Gobble space, Tur serves morning-inspired Thai dishes, egg plates, and several varieties of Thai-style congee.

enrichment.hook: Authentic Nepalese momos and Himalayan comfort food operating out of a San Francisco ghost kitchen facility.
enrichment.description: Happy Himalayan MoMo serves a variety of traditional meat and vegan momos, curries, and chow mein. The spot is available for pickup and delivery via online ordering platforms.

places.dba_name: 1182 Market St. United Nations Plaza. San Francisco, Ca 94102. Civic Center.
places.address: 1182 Market St United Nations Pla Ctr

enrichment.hook: A fast-casual sandwich location serving customizable footlongs, wraps, and salads on Geary Boulevard.
enrichment.description: A branch of the international fast-food chain Subway located at 5650 Geary Blvd in San Francisco, offering made-to-order sandwiches and salads.

enrichment.hook: A neighborhood convenience store and market located on Sacramento Street.
enrichment.description: Oregano Market is a convenience store and market operating at 3273 Sacramento St in San Francisco.

enrichment.hook: An expansion of the popular local food truck, bringing sliders, bowls, and tacos to Forest Hill.
enrichment.description: Upper Cut has opened a brick-and-mortar restaurant location near the Forest Hill station, offering a menu featuring sliders, tacos, bowls, and salads.

enrichment.hook: A Northern California sandwich chain location serving fresh deli favorites inside the Salesforce Transit Center.
enrichment.description: Located at 425 Mission Street, Erik's DeliCafe offers customizable deli sandwiches, fresh-made salads, and hot soups.

enrichment.hook: A Northern Thai restaurant in the Castro from Farmhouse Kitchen alums, serving regional specialties in handmade ceramic bowls.
enrichment.description: Located in the former Thai Chef space on 18th Street, Ka Kai specializes in herb-forward and slow-cooked northern Thai dishes crafted by chefs Pop Navapon and Tar Watcharin.

enrichment.hook: A LEED Platinum mixed-use residential community featuring interconnected six-story buildings and a central redwood grove in SOMA.
enrichment.description: 855 Brannan Apartments is a large multi-family residential development in San Francisco's SOMA/Design District offering hundreds of apartment homes, flex lofts, and shared amenities.

enrichment.hook: A long-standing Mediterranean bistro and wine bar in Cow Hollow serving small and large plates.
enrichment.description: Operating since 2006 in the Cow Hollow neighborhood, Terzo offers Mediterranean-inspired cuisine, seasonal local ingredients, and a globally curated wine list in a warm, modern setting.

enrichment.hook: Longtime mobile cocktail service and warehouse expanding to include a public-facing tasting bar in SoMa.
enrichment.description: Operators of Rye on the Road are working to turn a portion of their SoMa headquarters and commissary warehouse at 140 10th Street into a public-facing tasting bar.

enrichment.hook: A sprawling indoor taproom and kitchen in Mission Rock featuring Fieldwork's first-ever cocktail program.
enrichment.description: Fieldwork Brewing Company opened its Mission Rock taproom adjacent to China Basin Park, offering a full-service kitchen, rotating craft beers, and an extensive cocktail program.

enrichment.hook: Fresh, seasonal, and locally sourced catering specializing in customized menus across the San Francisco Bay Area.
enrichment.description: Bay Harvest Catering provides tailored drop-off and full-service catering featuring sustainable, locally sourced ingredients for corporate lunches, private events, and celebrations.

enrichment.hook: A flagship electric bicycle retailer and service center in the Mission District.
enrichment.description: The New Wheel consolidated its previous Bernal Heights showroom and Bayview service center into a unified retail store and service facility on Valencia Street.

enrichment.hook: An established North Beach Italian landmark carrying on its long-running traditions at a new location.
enrichment.description: Mona Lisa Restaurant & Bar operates at 414 Columbus Avenue, offering classic Italian dishes, seafood, and steaks following a transition and permit update.
